summary: The EV charging infrastructure space is anchored by well-funded leaders such as ChargePoint, EVgo, Electrify America, which set the pace on capability and distribution. A wave of earlier-stage challengers — including Terawatt Infrastructure — competes on focused differentiation and specific customer segments. The main axes of competition are product depth, integration into existing developer and buyer workflows, and go-to-market motion.
